title: Every Prehistoric Monster That Would Have Eaten Doug (Marathon)
card: EVERY PREHISTORIC THING THAT EATS DOUG
intro: Doug has been eaten by every era of prehistoric Earth. Giant sharks, armoured fish, sea monsters and fossils that still look alive. Here they all are, back to back. He is not ready.
description: Four full episodes, back to back: dying in every prehistoric ocean, the creepiest prehistoric animals scientists drew all wrong, the creepiest fossils that still look alive, and what lies deeper the more Doug digs. Real science, cartoon deaths.
